links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT-4 answers to complementary feeding questions
links.effect: 75% comprehensive, 20% correct but insufficient, no responses partially or completely incorrect; Cohen's kappa 0.859.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4 provided ”comprehensive” answers for 75% of questions and ”correct but insufficient” answers for 20%, with no responses deemed partially or completely incorrect.
